content.value: 'Your friend in the Urban and Regional Planning (URP) department is designing a plan (15)[CO3] to connect several islands with m bridges. The current design is not optimal, meaning some islands may be disconnected and some bridges may be redundant. Help your friend by writing an algorithm that identifies redundant bridges and computes the minimum number of additional bridges needed to make all islands connected.
